exact_source_preview_nodes.label: Min time to view on preview viewer to count as a view:

native_source.source_review_scope: Exact named declaration in the cited file; qualified owner checked. No proximity/old-offset inference.

exact_source_preview_nodes.assessment: The exact preview minimum Options row stages until Apply, retains the 5-second default, None/count-every-view and recorded 50ms widget minimum, imports/persists and reopens. Its concrete native consumer is the separately displayed focused-file still/poster preview, not thumbnail selection. Accepted current rendered frames retain their request timestamp; failed/loading/retired frames create no interval. Same-file redraw does not restart, page/file generation changes and clear/hide finish, restoring a page begins another interval, splitter reveal waits for changed focus, and accepted client close is terminal while declined close preserves the display. Finish reads the live active/minimum/cap policy and counts only intervals meeting the minimum after capping, preserving Preview canvas1 separately from media views.

exact_source_preview_nodes.label: Cap any view on the preview viewer to this maximum time:

native_source.source_review_scope: Exact named declaration in the cited file; qualified owner checked. No proximity/old-offset inference.

exact_source_preview_nodes.assessment: The exact preview maximum Options row stages until Apply, retains the 60-second default, None/no-limit and recorded 1-second widget minimum, imports/persists and reopens. The real owned preview display reads its saved cap at interval finish, extends a finite cap to at least five times the file's actual stored duration, caps elapsed time before checking the preview minimum, and leaves None unlimited. Options Apply reaches an already-open interval, Cancel/retired Apply preserves saved limits, closed/rebound owners finish once, and late decode/page callbacks cannot charge another display. Persisted Preview canvas1 counts/durations/timestamps survive Store reopening separately from media/filter statistics.
